title: Print Words Vertically
sourceKind: third-party mirrors via web search (official page not fetchable)
summary: Return the words of s read vertically: row k holds the k-th character of each word in order, padded with spaces, with trailing spaces removed.
officialConstraints: 1 <= s.length <= 200; uppercase English letters with words separated by a single space.

examples.input: TO BE OR NOT TO BE

visualizationNotes: Mirrors disagree on whether spaces appear in s; the visualization accepts uppercase words with single spaces, which matches the single-space separator rule. Leading padding is kept; trailing spaces are removed.
